verdict.rationale: The x402 Bazaar exposes machine-readable listings (price, network/asset/scheme filters, ranked search, OpenAPI client, MCP tool calls) covering price, availability (delisted after 30 days without settlement) and pricing variants (fixed/usage/batch), per docs-5/6/22 and supp-5/6. However x402 explicitly replaces 'checkout pages' with a signed-payment HTTP handshake rather than exposing checkout links, and probes show no public top-level OpenAPI spec, so the 'checkout links' element of the story is unaddressed. Missing for 10: documented checkout-link fields in offer data, independent/hands-on confirmation of Bazaar query responses, and a working public OpenAPI schema.
